chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ishaq ibn Ghalib, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام.
In a sermon of his, specifically mentioning therein the state of the Prophet and the Imams عليهم السلام and their qualities.

So our Lord, by reason of His forbearance, deliberateness, and compassion, was not prevented by the enormity of their crimes and the ugliness of their deeds from choosing for them the most beloved of His Prophets to Him, and the most honored of them before Him, Muhammad ibn Abdillah عليه السلام. His birth was in the very midst of honor, and his lineage-root in the depth of nobility; his ancestry was unblemished, his lineage unmixed, and his description was not unknown to the people of knowledge. The Prophets gave glad tidings of him in their books, the scholars spoke of him in their descriptions, and the wise pondered him through his attributes. Refined, unmatched; Hashimite, without equal; of al-Abtah, unsurpassed. His trait was modesty, and his nature generosity; formed upon the dignities and morals of prophethood, stamped upon the qualities and forbearances of messengership, until the causes of the decrees of Allah reached in him their appointed times, and by the command of Allah the decree proceeded concerning him to its final ends; the inevitable decree of Allah brought him to its utmost goals.

Every community gave glad tidings of him to the one after it, and every father passed him on to a father, from loins to loins. No illicit union mixed his substance, and no unlawful relation defiled him in his birth, from Adam to his father Abdillah, within the best lineage-group, the noblest stock, the strongest clan, the most protected womb, and the safest lap.

Allah chose him, approved him, and selected him, and gave him the keys of knowledge and the springs of wisdom. He sent him as a mercy to the servants and a springtime for the lands, and Allah sent down to him the Book, in which are clear expression and full clarification.
“An Arabic Qur'an, without any crookedness, so that they may attain taqwa.”

He has made it clear for the people, laid out its path with knowledge, detailed it, clarified a religion, obligated duties, defined limits for the people and explained them, and disclosed matters to His creation and proclaimed them. In it are indications toward salvation and landmarks that call toward His guidance.

So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله conveyed what he was sent with, proclaimed openly what he was commanded with, fulfilled what he had been burdened with from the weights of prophethood, showed patience for his Lord, strove in His way, sincerely advised his community, called them to salvation, urged them to dhikr, and guided them to the path of guidance by means of ways and calls whose foundations he established for the servants, and by beacons whose signs he raised for them, so that they might not go astray after him; and he was toward them compassionate and merciful.

key_terms.أَوْقَارِ النُّبُوَّةِ: The dignified qualities and gravities of prophethood
key_terms.اِنْتَجَبَ: He selected and chose with special preference
key_terms.حِلْمِهِ: His forbearance and restraint in dealing with creation
key_terms.مَحْتِدُهُ: His ancestral root and noble family origin
key_terms.مَفَاتِيحَهُ: Its keys, meaning the openings and access points of knowledge
key_terms.مَقَادِيرِ اللَّهِ: The divine determinations and decreed measures of Allah
key_terms.مَنَارٍ: Beacons or landmarks set up to indicate guidance

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the lineage, character, and mission of the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: This sermon describes the noble lineage, pre-eternal recognition, exalted character, and divinely decreed mission of the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله. It presents him as Allah’s chosen mercy, bearer of the clarifying Qur'an, and the one who fully conveyed the message, guided the الأمة, and established enduring signs of guidance.
